annotation_policy.conversation_workflow: After recording each creator-provided label or skip request, generate and present the next pending sample without asking whether to continue.
annotation_policy.corrections: Revise the existing entry with the same id; preserve the creator's correction wording.

difficulty_normalization.note: Normal difficulty is stored as success, matching server/check_turn.py DIFFICULTIES; preserve the creator's original difficulty wording in raw_response.

annotation_policy.incomplete_annotations: Keep incomplete labels in pending_examples, preserving the creator's raw response. Optional rationale may remain null.
annotation_policy.missing_label_details: Apply the creator's explicit defaults; leave other unspecified fields null. Do not invent skills, roll systems, difficulty, or rationale.
annotation_policy.no_roll: A creator-confirmed no-roll label uses roll_required: false and checks: []. Pending annotations are null.

roll_system_default.condition: The creator gives one skill and a difficulty without specifying the roll system.
roll_system_default.instruction_zh: 如果只说一个技能和难度，那你默认是单向投掷就行了。

annotation_policy.skill_validation: Resolve the creator's English or Chinese skill wording to a canonical SkillBank name and verify that it exists. If no matching skill exists or the mapping is uncertain, notify the creator, preserve the raw response, and keep the sample pending. Never silently substitute another skill.
annotation_policy.skipped_examples: Keep creator-skipped scenes in skipped_examples with their original scene, action and skip_reason_raw. They remain unlabeled and are excluded from training examples.
annotation_policy.training_examples: Only creator-labeled entries with a roll_required decision belong in examples. If a roll is required, each check must have kind, name, difficulty and roll_system after applying creator defaults. Confirmed no-roll entries have checks: [].
annotation_policy.unknown_skill_attempts: Preserve unrecognized skill replies in the pending sample's annotation_attempts, while annotation remains null. Ask the creator to resolve the skill before accepting the label; never substitute a suggested skill without their confirmation.
annotation_policy.conditional_examples: Keep creator-labeled conditional rules in conditional_examples, scoped to their original sample. Branches are mutually exclusive alternatives, not simultaneous checks. Export a fixed-difficulty training row only after its observed state selects exactly one labeled branch; do not assume missing state or infer labels for uncovered conditions.
annotation_policy.non_dialogue_inputs: Describe actual observed actions and relevant state for non-dialogue check triggers. A statement of intended action alone does not establish that it occurred. Existing declared-action examples retain their original inputs and must not be silently reinterpreted as runtime observations.
annotation_policy.attribute_validation: Validate attribute checks against the supported attribute identifiers; store them with kind: attribute, not as skill names.
annotation_policy.parameterized_examples: Creator-labeled general cases whose skill depends on an explicit scenario parameter belong in parameterized_examples. A skill selector preserves the creator's parameter without inventing a canonical name. Keep fixed_row_ready false until all selectors bind to valid catalog skills; do not export unresolved selectors as fixed-skill examples.
annotation_policy.check_mode: Record creator-confirmed single-entry or paired checks as check_mode: single or pair. Pair describes two entries evaluated together; its individual threshold checks follow the project's roll_pair definition.
annotation_policy.alternative_examples: Creator-approved interchangeable options belong in alternative_examples. choice: one_of means select one complete option; the options are not simultaneous checks. Every listed option is an accepted label. Preserve the accepted set when exporting, or record an explicitly selected option; do not silently choose one.
annotation_policy.optional_rolls: roll_required: false with roll_optional: true means no check is required by default, but the creator permits an optional check. Preserve that discretion when exporting; do not interpret it as a prohibition on rolling. Store only explicitly supplied optional-check parameters and failure guidance, leaving unspecified mechanics and consequences unset.

description.en: General scenes generated by the assistant and labeled by the creator for whether a dice check is required and which check to use. Meridia-specific scenes are reserved for testing.
description.zh: 由助手生成通用场景，由创作者标注是否需要骰子检定及采用的检定。Meridia 专属场景留作测试集。

player_action.en: I grip the gaps between the stones, climb to the top with my bare hands, and get over into the courtyard.
player_action.zh: 我抓住石缝，徒手爬上墙顶，再翻进院子。

scene.en: The rain has just stopped. An uninjured character in normal physical condition stands outside a stone wall about three metres high and wants to get into the courtyard. The wall is slippery, but gaps between the stones offer handholds and footholds. The character has no rope or ladder and no companion to help. There is no pursuit or time limit. Losing their grip during the climb could cause a fall.
scene.zh: 雨刚停。一名身体正常、没有受伤的角色站在一堵约三米高的石墙外，想翻墙进入院子。石墙表面湿滑，但石块之间有可供手脚抓踩的缝隙。角色没有绳索或梯子，也没有同伴协助；现场没有追兵或时间限制。攀爬途中失手可能导致摔落。

player_action.en: I reach out, pick up the book on the desk, and look at its cover.
player_action.zh: 我伸手拿起桌上的书，看看封面。

scene.en: An uninjured character in normal physical condition stands in a quiet, well-lit public reading room. A book lies on an ordinary desk within easy reach. Readers are allowed to pick up the books on the desks. Nobody is stopping the character, and there is no time limit.
scene.zh: 一名身体正常、没有受伤的角色站在安静、光线充足的公共阅览室里。一张普通书桌上放着一本书，距离角色伸手可及。阅览室允许读者自行取阅桌上的书，现场没有人阻拦，也没有时间限制。

player_action.en: I stay seated, concentrate, and try to make out their conversation.
player_action.zh: 我坐着不动，集中注意力，试着听清他们的谈话。

scene.en: The tavern is crowded and noisy, with music, laughter, and scraping chairs overlapping. Two strangers at a table about three metres away are speaking quietly. The character has normal hearing and wants to know what they are discussing, but intends to remain seated without moving closer.
scene.zh: 酒馆里人声嘈杂，乐声、笑声和拖动椅子的声音交织在一起。两名陌生人坐在约三米外的一张桌旁，压低声音交谈。角色听力正常，想知道他们在谈论什么，但打算留在原座位，不靠近对方。

player_action.en: I point to the worn straps and say: This backpack needs some repairs. How about 35 copper coins? I can buy it right now.
player_action.zh: 我指着磨损的肩带说：这背包还得修一修。35枚铜币，我现在就买，你看怎么样？

scene.en: A market merchant asks 50 copper coins for a used backpack. It is still usable, but its shoulder straps are visibly worn. The merchant is willing to hear offers but has not agreed to a discount. The character can afford the asking price but wants to pay 35 copper coins. They have no prior agreement or personal relationship.
scene.zh: 集市上的商人给一个旧背包开价50枚铜币。背包仍然能用，但肩带有明显磨损。商人愿意听顾客议价，尚未答应降价。角色有足够的钱支付原价，但想以35枚铜币买下背包，双方没有事先约定或私人交情。

player_action.en: I use the tools to work the lock and try to open the chest.
player_action.zh: 我用工具试着拨动锁芯，把箱子打开。

scene.en: An ordinary wooden chest is locked, and the character has lock-picking tools suitable for its lock. There is no time pressure, and the character wants to open it without damaging the chest or lock.
scene.zh: 一只普通木箱上着锁，角色手边有适用于这把锁的开锁工具。没有时间限制，角色希望打开箱子，同时保持箱体和锁完好。

player_action.en: I hold up my tools and say, “I was sent to fix a leaking pipe. I need to get inside and take a look.”
player_action.zh: 我举起工具，说：「我是被派来修漏水的管子的，需要进去看看。」

scene.en: The character arrives at a guarded archive entrance carrying plumbing tools, without a pass, work order, or repair assignment. The guard does not recognize them and asks, “What brings you here?”
scene.zh: 角色带着水管维修工具来到有人把守的档案馆门口，没有通行证或维修工单，也没有接到维修任务。守卫不认识角色，问：「你来做什么？」

annotation.raw_response: 我们有导航这个技能吗，有的话就是普通导航

player_action.en: I compare the stream and hill on the map with their positions around me to work out which branch leads toward camp.
player_action.zh: 我把地图上的溪流和山丘与眼前的位置对照，判断哪条岔路通向营地。

scene.en: The character reaches an unmarked fork on a forest trail and wants to reach camp before nightfall. Their paper map marks the camp, a stream, and a hill; both landmarks are visible, but they have no compass.
scene.zh: 角色沿着林间小径走到一个没有路标的岔口，希望在天黑前抵达营地。手上的纸质地图标出了营地、溪流和山丘，眼前能看见溪流和山丘，但角色没有指南针。

player_action.en: I crouch down to examine the boot print and nearby ground, trying to determine which direction the person was travelling.
player_action.zh: 我蹲下查看这枚靴印和附近地面，试着判断留下脚印的人往哪个方向走了。

scene.en: After the rain, the character notices a boot print in soft mud beside a forest path. It is daylight, with no immediate time pressure.
scene.zh: 雨后，角色在林间小路旁的软泥里发现一枚靴印。现在是白天，没有迫在眉睫的时间压力。

player_action.en: I pick up the pendant, inspect the scratches and maker’s mark, and estimate a fair price to pay for it.
player_action.zh: 我拿起吊坠，仔细查看划痕和刻记，估计买下它的合理价格。

scene.en: At a market, a merchant lets the character examine an unfamiliar silver-looking pendant with visible scratches and a small engraved maker’s mark. There is no certificate, testing equipment, or time pressure.
scene.zh: 集市上，商人允许角色查看一枚不熟悉的银色吊坠，表面有划痕和一个细小的制造者刻记。没有鉴定证书或检测工具，也没有时间压力。

player_action.en: I step back, take a running start, and attempt to jump the gap onto the other side of the bridge.
player_action.zh: 我退后几步，助跑，试着跳到对面的桥上。

scene.en: A broken stone footbridge has a gap about two metres wide, with dry, stable edges and enough flat space on the character’s side for a run-up. A shallow, rocky stream lies below; there are no pursuers or time limits.
scene.zh: 一座断裂的石制步行桥中间有约两米宽的缺口，两侧边缘干燥稳固，角色这一侧有足够平坦的空间助跑。桥下是布满石块的浅溪，没有追兵，也没有时间限制。

player_action.en: I examine the joint, then try to refit and secure the leg so the chair can support someone sitting normally.
player_action.zh: 我先检查连接处，再试着重新装好并固定椅腿，让椅子能正常坐人。

scene.en: In a well-lit workshop, an old wooden chair has a loose leg, with ordinary woodworking tools and materials available. The owner permits repairs, and there is no time limit.
scene.zh: 光线充足的工作坊里，一把旧木椅有条松动的椅腿，手边有普通木工工具和材料。主人允许维修，没有时间限制。

player_action.en: I look closely at its leaves and flowers without touching it, trying to identify the plant.
player_action.zh: 我凑近观察它的叶片和花朵，不触碰它，试着认出这是什么植物。

scene.en: The character notices an unfamiliar blue-flowered plant beside a path. It is daylight, the leaves and flowers can be examined closely, and there is no reference book or time pressure.
scene.zh: 角色在小路旁发现一株不认识的蓝花植物。现在是白天，可以近距离看清叶片和花朵，但手边没有植物图鉴，也没有时间压力。

player_action.en: I observe the watchman’s patrol route, then move between the crates when he looks away, trying to stay quiet.
player_action.zh: 我先观察守卫的巡视路线，等他看向别处时，在木箱之间移动，尽量不发出声音。

scene.en: At night, the character wants to cross a warehouse yard and reach the rear door unnoticed; a watchman is near the lit front entrance, crates offer cover, and gravel covers the ground. There is no deadline, and the character can observe the watchman’s patrol route first.
scene.zh: 夜里，角色想穿过仓库院子，在不被发现的情况下到达后门；守卫位于亮着灯的正门附近，院内的木箱可以遮挡视线，地面铺着碎石。没有时间限制，角色可以先观察守卫的巡视路线。

player_action.en: I examine the rock closely with the hand lens, trying to identify what kind of rock it is.
player_action.zh: 我用放大镜仔细查看这块石头，试着判断它属于哪种岩石。

scene.en: In daylight, the character finds an unfamiliar pale grey rock on a riverbank. They can use a hand lens to inspect its colour, grains, and any layering, but have no reference book or other testing equipment and face no time pressure.
scene.zh: 白天，角色在河岸发现一块不认识的浅灰色石头。可以用手持放大镜观察颜色、颗粒和是否有层理，但没有参考书或其他检测设备，也没有时间压力。

annotation_history.skip_reason_raw: 换一个sample，这个有点处于要投掷和不要的边缘

player_action.en: I sing the familiar song without accompaniment, hoping the guests will enjoy it.
player_action.zh: 我不借助伴奏，唱起这首熟悉的歌，希望让客人们听得开心。

scene.en: At a small inn, the character agrees to sing a familiar song for several willing listeners, and the room is quiet enough for everyone to hear. Their voice is in its usual condition, with no deadline or pressure to perform.
scene.zh: 在一家小旅店里，角色答应为几位愿意听歌的客人唱一首熟悉的歌，房间安静得足以听清歌声。角色嗓音状态正常，没有时间限制，也没有人强迫其表演。

player_action.en: I try to swim to the bank and get out before the current carries me farther downstream.
player_action.zh: 我试着游到岸边，赶在被水流冲得更远之前上岸。

scene.en: The character accidentally falls into a fast-flowing river, with the nearest bank about six metres away. They are wearing ordinary clothes, have no rope or flotation aid within reach, and the current is carrying them downstream.
scene.zh: 角色意外落入一条水流湍急的河中，最近的河岸约六米远。角色穿着普通衣物，伸手范围内没有绳索或漂浮物，水流正将其不断带向下游。

player_action.en: I try to heat and reshape the hinge so it fits the door properly again and allows it to close.
player_action.zh: 我试着加热并修整铰链，让它重新合适地装在门上，使门能够关上。

scene.en: An iron hinge on the village smithy’s door bent during a storm; the metal is unbroken, but the door cannot close, and more rain is expected later today. The owner permits repairs, and an ordinary forge and tools are available.
scene.zh: 村里铁匠铺的铁铰链在暴风雨中弯曲，虽然没有断裂，却导致门无法关闭，而今天晚些时候还会下雨。主人允许角色修理，现场有可用的锻炉和普通工具。
村里用来磨粮的手摇磨机卡住了。磨盘为石制，传动齿轮和转轴为铁制，支撑框架为木制。齿轮罩已经打开，内部齿轮的排列清晰可见，但卡住的具体原因还没有确定。旁边有普通工具，村民需要在傍晚前磨完这批粮食。
scene.en: The village's hand-cranked grain mill has jammed. Its millstones are stone, its transmission gears and shafts are iron, and its supporting frame is wood. The gear housing is open and the gear arrangement is clearly visible, but the cause of the jam is still unknown. Ordinary tools are available, and the villagers need this batch of grain milled before evening.

player_action.zh: 我先仔细查看齿轮之间的连接和各个部件的状态，试着找出卡住的原因，再动手修理。
player_action.en: I examine how the gears connect and the condition of the components, trying to identify the cause of the jam before attempting repairs.

clarifications.question_raw: 什么材质的grain mill?石头的？

answer.zh: 这条场景中，磨盘是石制的，传动齿轮和转轴是铁制的，支撑框架是木制的。卡住的具体原因还没有确定；角色当前要先检查并找出原因，再考虑修理。
answer.en: In this sample, the millstones are stone, the transmission gears and shafts are iron, and the supporting frame is wood. The cause of the jam is still unknown; the character is examining the mechanism to identify the cause before attempting repairs.

scene.zh: 角色独自一人、没有受伤，当前不在战斗中，脚下地面干燥平整。通向房间的厚重木门没有上锁或闩住，但被变形的门框卡住；走廊里的烟雾正在向角色所在位置蔓延。
scene.en: The character is alone, uninjured, and outside combat, standing on dry, level flooring. A heavy wooden door leading into a room is unlocked and unlatched but jammed by its warped frame; smoke is spreading along the corridor toward the character.

observed_event.zh: 角色用双臂和肩膀向门施力，试图推开它，没有使用工具；门是否被推开尚未结算。
observed_event.en: The character presses against the door with their arms and shoulder, attempting to push it open without tools; whether the door yields remains unresolved.

scene.zh: 当前不在战斗中。一名同伴在搬运时被破裂的玻璃划伤前臂，伤口持续流血，已经浸透按在上面的手帕；他意识清醒，能够配合。角色身边有干净的布和绷带，附近暂时没有医师。
scene.en: The scene is outside combat. A companion cut their forearm on broken glass while carrying supplies. The wound continues to bleed and has soaked through the handkerchief held against it; the companion is conscious and cooperative. The character has clean cloth and bandages, but no physician is immediately available.

observed_event.zh: 角色正在用干净的布压住伤口，并用绷带固定敷料，尝试控制出血；止血是否成功尚未结算。
observed_event.en: The character is pressing clean cloth against the wound and securing the dressing with a bandage, attempting to control the bleeding; whether the bleeding is controlled remains unresolved.

scene.zh: 当前不在战斗中。角色驾驶一辆装着粮袋的单马货车，沿雨后泥泞的下坡路行进。前方是一个急弯，外侧紧邻排水沟；马匹没有受惊，但货车正因坡度逐渐加速。
scene.en: Outside combat, the character drives a single-horse wagon loaded with sacks of grain down a muddy road after rain. A sharp bend lies ahead, with a drainage ditch along its outer edge. The horse is calm, but the wagon is gradually gaining speed on the slope.

observed_event.zh: 角色开始拉紧缰绳并操作货车的手刹，尝试控制速度、让货车沿道路转过急弯。车轮能否保持在路面上尚未结算。
observed_event.en: The character draws back on the reins and operates the wagon’s handbrake, attempting to control its speed and steer around the bend. Whether the wheels stay on the road remains unresolved.

scene.zh: 当前不在战斗中。角色独自在山林中过夜，持续降雨，气温正在下降。附近没有洞穴或房屋；角色找到一块略高于周围积水的空地，手边有一张防水帆布、绳索和几根粗细不一的枯枝，阵风不断吹动树冠。
scene.en: Outside combat, the character must spend the night alone in a mountain forest. Rain continues and the temperature is falling. With no cave or building nearby, they find a patch of ground slightly above the surrounding puddles. They have a waterproof canvas sheet, rope, and several fallen branches of varying thickness; gusts keep shaking the treetops.

observed_event.zh: 角色正在用枯枝搭设支撑，将帆布绑在支撑和树干上，并用石块压住边缘，搭建能供自己避雨过夜的临时庇护所；搭建是否成功、能否承受当前的风雨尚未结算。
observed_event.en: The character arranges branches as supports, ties the canvas to them and nearby trunks, and weighs down its edges with stones, building a temporary shelter for the night. Whether the shelter is successfully assembled and withstands the current wind and rain remains unresolved.

scene.zh: 当前不在战斗中。角色是一名熟悉长笛演奏和乐谱阅读的乐手，正在参加剧院乐队的招募试演。考官给出一段此前没有见过的十六小节乐谱，其中有连续的快速换指和节奏变化。角色有两分钟看谱准备，不能预先吹奏。长笛状态良好，试演室安静；能否按谱面速度准确完成演奏，将影响录用结果。
scene.en: Outside combat, the character is a musician familiar with playing the flute and reading sheet music, auditioning for a theater orchestra. The examiner provides an unfamiliar sixteen-bar passage containing consecutive rapid fingering changes and shifts in rhythm. The character has two minutes to study the score without playing it beforehand. The flute is in good condition and the audition room is quiet; an accurate performance at the written tempo will affect the hiring decision.

observed_event.zh: 角色已经开始按谱吹奏这段乐曲；能否以要求的速度准确完成演奏尚未结算。
observed_event.en: The character has begun playing the passage from the score; whether they complete it accurately at the required tempo remains unresolved.

scene.zh: 当前不在战斗中。角色在设备齐全、照明良好的实验室里检查一包标签脱落的白色粉末。进货记录显示，它只可能是清单上的四种常用实验材料之一；这四种材料外观相近，但化学性质不同。角色能查阅它们的性质资料，手边有完好的检测器具、足量试剂和防护用品，并有半小时完成鉴别。
scene.en: Outside combat, the character examines a packet of white powder with a missing label in a well-equipped, brightly lit laboratory. Delivery records narrow it down to four common laboratory materials with similar appearances but different chemical properties. Reference information on each material is available, along with functioning testing equipment, sufficient reagents, and protective equipment. The character has half an hour to identify it.

observed_event.zh: 角色已经取出少量样品开始检测，并将观察到的反应与资料逐项比较，尝试确定粉末对应清单上的哪一种材料；能否正确鉴别尚未结算。
observed_event.en: The character has taken a small sample and begun testing it, comparing the observed reactions with the reference information to determine which listed material it is. Whether the identification is correct remains unresolved.

scene.zh: 当前不在战斗中。角色正在参加射箭比赛，需要用自己的短弓命中二十五米外草靶上直径二十厘米的红色靶心，才能晋级。角色熟悉这把弓，弓弦和箭矢完好。场地光线充足，射线上没有遮挡，侧面持续吹来轻风；这一轮只允许射一箭。
scene.en: Outside combat, the character is competing in an archery contest. To advance, they must use their own shortbow to hit a red bullseye twenty centimeters across on a straw target twenty-five meters away. They are familiar with the bow, and the string and arrow are in good condition. Lighting is clear, the shooting lane is unobstructed, and a steady light crosswind is blowing. Only one shot is allowed this round.

observed_event.zh: 角色站在射线后，拉弓瞄准红色靶心并放出箭矢；这一箭是否命中靶心尚未结算。
observed_event.en: Standing behind the shooting line, the character draws the bow, aims at the red bullseye, and releases the arrow. Whether the shot hits the bullseye remains unresolved.

annotation.raw_response: 普通弓箭（射击）。就算在战斗也是判定弓箭的

basis.zh: 当前技能表区分 Longbow 和 Shortbow；本场景明确使用短弓，因此将创作者的弓箭射击表述对应为 Shortbow。
basis.en: The current skill catalog distinguishes Longbow and Shortbow. The scene explicitly uses a shortbow, so the creator's bow-shooting wording is resolved to Shortbow.

creator_guidance.raw_response: 就算在战斗也是判定弓箭的

rule.zh: 弓箭射击在战斗中仍使用相应弓类技能判定。
rule.en: Bow shots still use the appropriate bow skill in combat.

label_scope.zh: 该补充说明技能选择；战斗中的难度和投掷制度未在这句话中标注。本条普通难度和默认单向投掷对应原有的非战斗场景。
label_scope.en: This clarification specifies skill selection. Combat difficulty and roll system are not labeled by this statement. This example's normal difficulty and default unidirectional roll apply to its original noncombat scene.

scene.zh: 当前不在战斗中。角色正在协助博物馆整理一面年代标签遗失的旧军旗。旗上的王室徽记、统治者姓名和军团番号仍清晰可辨。角色曾系统学习这个地区的历史，但已经数年没有接触相关资料；现场没有可查阅的史书。馆员需要先判断军旗属于哪个统治时期，才能安排后续档案检索。
scene.en: Outside combat, the character is helping a museum catalogue an old military banner whose date label is missing. Its royal emblem, ruler's name, and regiment number remain clearly legible. The character formally studied this region's history several years ago but has not consulted the subject recently; no history books are available on site. The curator needs an initial identification of the banner's reign to direct the subsequent archive search.

observed_event.zh: 角色正在仔细查看旗上的姓名与徽记，将它们与自己记得的统治者更替和军团沿革对照，尝试判断军旗所属的统治时期；判断是否正确尚未结算。
observed_event.en: The character examines the name and emblem, comparing them with their recollection of successive rulers and regimental history to identify the reign the banner belongs to. Whether the identification is correct remains unresolved.

annotation.raw_response: 等下。所以玩家只是看年份，没有找东西。如果不找东西那就是纯普通历史。找东西就是普通历史+普通阅读（某国家当时统治时期的语言）

creator_guidance.raw_response: 不。需要查阅的那个case直接生成000029

rule.zh: 本条对应不查阅资料、仅凭已有历史知识判断年代的情况；查阅资料的情况单独保存为 dice_train_000029。
rule.en: This example covers identifying the period from existing historical knowledge without consulting records. The record-consultation case is stored separately as dice_train_000029.

scene.zh: 当前不在战斗中。角色刚在明亮的房间里与一名信使交谈了五分钟，清楚看到了对方的脸。信使已经离开；一名没见过信使的同伴需要稍后在人群中认出他。角色有纸、炭笔和十分钟时间，可以凭记忆画出肖像，但没有照片或其他画像可参考。
scene.en: Outside combat, the character has just spent five minutes talking to a courier in a well-lit room and saw their face clearly. The courier has left. A companion who has never met the courier needs to recognize them in a crowd later. The character has paper, charcoal, and ten minutes to draw a portrait from memory, with no photograph or other portrait available.

observed_event.zh: 角色已经开始画出信使的脸部轮廓与五官，并调整比例，尝试完成一张足以供同伴辨认的肖像；画出的脸是否足够准确尚未结算。
observed_event.en: The character has begun sketching the courier’s facial outline and features, adjusting their proportions to produce a recognizable likeness for the companion. Whether the drawing is sufficiently accurate remains unresolved.

basis.zh: 本场景的美术任务是绘制肖像，对应当前技能表的 Drawing。
basis.en: The art task in this scene is drawing a portrait, corresponding to Drawing in the current skill catalog.

scene.zh: 当前不在战斗中。角色代表一家旅店，与木工作坊商谈修复十扇受损窗户的合同。旅店必须在七天后的客人入住前完成维修，预算最多为120枚银币；作坊报价140枚银币，并要求预付一半。作坊有能力按期完工，但曾被其他客户拖欠款项；旅店则担心提前付款后工程延期。双方都希望成交，目前尚未达成协议。
scene.en: Outside combat, the character represents an inn in contract talks with a carpentry workshop about repairing ten damaged windows. The inn needs the work completed before guests arrive in seven days and can spend at most 120 silver coins. The workshop has quoted 140 and requested half in advance. It can finish on time but has previously suffered unpaid invoices; the inn fears delays after paying in advance. Both parties want an agreement, but none has been reached.

observed_event.zh: 角色已经向作坊负责人提出：总价120枚银币，签约支付40枚，每修好并验收五扇窗户再支付40枚；旅店另行提供工匠这七天的午餐，合同写明完工日期。角色正在解释分阶段付款如何保障双方，负责人是否接受这套条款尚未结算。
observed_event.en: The character has proposed a total of 120 silver coins: 40 at signing and another 40 after each batch of five windows is repaired and accepted. The inn will also provide the carpenters with lunch for seven days, and the contract will specify the completion date. The character is explaining how staged payments protect both parties; whether the workshop owner accepts these terms remains unresolved.

scene.zh: 当前不在战斗中。角色正在参加餐馆厨师的试工，需要在十五分钟内同时交出四份煎鱼配热酱汁。鱼片已经去骨，食材新鲜，配方和分量明确；三个炉头、两口煎锅、一只小锅及其他厨具均可正常使用。主厨要求鱼肉熟透但保持嫩度、鱼皮酥脆，酱汁不能油水分离；成品质量将决定是否录用。
scene.en: Outside combat, the character is taking a restaurant cooking trial and must serve four portions of pan-fried fish with warm sauce together within fifteen minutes. The fillets are deboned, the ingredients are fresh, and the recipe and quantities are clear. Three burners, two frying pans, a saucepan, and the other utensils are in working order. The head chef requires fully cooked but tender fish, crisp skin, and sauce that has not separated; the finished dishes will determine whether the character is hired.

observed_event.zh: 角色已经将鱼片下锅，正在调整火力、判断翻面时机，并同时搅拌加热酱汁；能否按时完成四份符合要求的菜品尚未结算。
observed_event.en: The character has placed the fillets in the pans and is adjusting the heat and judging when to turn them while stirring and heating the sauce. Whether all four dishes meet the requirements and are ready on time remains unresolved.

scene.zh: 当前不在战斗中。角色受雇为一座庭院核算铺石面积，采购员将在十五分钟后根据结果订料。庭院外缘是不规则六边形，中央有一座不需要铺石的圆形水池。角色手中有经过核实的平面图，比例尺、各段尺寸、角度和水池半径均标注完整；可以使用纸笔和尺子，没有现成的面积计算结果。
scene.en: Outside combat, the character is hired to calculate the area to be paved in a courtyard. A buyer will order materials from the result in fifteen minutes. The courtyard has an irregular hexagonal boundary and a circular pool in the middle that requires no paving. The character has a verified plan with a scale, all dimensions and angles, and the pool radius. Paper, pencils, and a ruler are available; no area calculation has been provided.

observed_event.zh: 角色已经开始在图上划分几何区域，计算各部分面积并扣除水池所占面积，求出需要铺石的净面积；计算结果是否准确尚未结算。
observed_event.en: The character has begun dividing the plan into geometric regions, calculating their areas, and subtracting the pool's area to determine the net area requiring paving. Whether the calculation is accurate remains unresolved.

scene.zh: 当前不在战斗中。角色正在安静的休息室里，与一名自愿接受访谈的仓库事故目击者交谈，整理事故经过。目击者没有受伤，可以随时暂停。谈到当天的工作安排时，他语速平稳；谈到货架倒塌时，他仍微笑着说自己没事，却开始反复揉搓袖口、停顿，并把话题转回货物损失。角色需要决定是否暂停访谈，让对方休息。
scene.en: Outside combat, the character is interviewing a willing witness to a warehouse accident in a quiet break room to reconstruct what happened. The witness is uninjured and may pause at any time. He speaks steadily about the day's work schedule. When discussing the shelves collapsing, he smiles and says he is fine, but repeatedly rubs his sleeve, pauses, and redirects the conversation to damaged goods. The character needs to decide whether to pause the interview so he can rest.

observed_event.zh: 角色正在结合对方的语气、停顿、动作和话题变化，并询问他谈起事故时的感受，尝试判断对方当前的紧张程度；判断是否准确尚未结算。
observed_event.en: The character considers the witness's tone, pauses, movements, and topic changes and asks how discussing the accident feels, attempting to assess his current level of distress. Whether the assessment is accurate remains unresolved.

scene.zh: 当前不在战斗中。角色在工坊检查一套桌面滑轮模型：绳子一端固定在横梁上，向下绕过连接木箱的动滑轮，再向上绕过横梁上的定滑轮，另一端挂着配重。木箱连同动滑轮共重600克，配重重400克，质量均已核实。绳子质量和滑轮摩擦可以忽略；木箱和配重目前由支架托住，角色需要在撤去支架前判断木箱会向哪个方向运动，无须计算速度或加速度。
scene.en: Outside combat, the character examines a tabletop pulley model in a workshop. One end of a rope is anchored to a beam, passes down around a movable pulley attached to a wooden box, then up over a fixed pulley on the beam; a counterweight hangs from the other end. The box and movable pulley together have a verified mass of 600 grams, and the counterweight has a verified mass of 400 grams. Rope mass and pulley friction are negligible. Supports currently hold both loads in place. The character must predict which way the box will move when the supports are removed, without calculating its speed or acceleration.

observed_event.zh: 角色已经开始沿绳索的走向分析木箱和配重受到的拉力，并据此判断撤去支架后木箱会上升还是下降；判断是否正确尚未结算。
observed_event.en: The character has begun tracing the rope's path and analyzing the tension acting on the box and counterweight to determine whether the box will rise or fall when the supports are removed; the accuracy of the prediction remains unresolved.

scene.zh: 当前不在战斗中。角色在城外的观测台上，看到一颗自己不熟悉的明亮天体。夜空晴朗，附近几颗恒星清晰可见。桌上有标注完整的星图，以及前四个夜晚记录这颗亮点相对附近恒星位置的观测图；各次记录的日期和时间明确。角色有半小时继续观测和对照资料。
scene.en: Outside combat, the character is at an observation platform outside town, examining an unfamiliar bright celestial object. The sky is clear, and several nearby stars are plainly visible. A fully labeled star chart and observation drawings recording the object's position relative to nearby stars on the previous four nights are available, each with a clear date and time. The character has half an hour to continue observing and comparing the records.

observed_event.zh: 角色正在将亮点今夜的位置与先前的观测记录、星图对照，尝试判断它是否是一颗行星；判断是否正确尚未结算。
observed_event.en: The character is comparing the object's position tonight with the earlier observation records and star chart to determine whether it is a planet; whether that judgment is correct remains unresolved.

scene.zh: 当前不在战斗中。角色是商队领队，正在办公室里单独询问一名仓库管理员，追查一批被私自转移的货物。管理员知道货物藏在哪里，但一直替参与转移的同伙隐瞒。角色手中有管理员签名的出库单；管理员知道领队有权将自己逐出商队，也很怕失去这份收入稳定的工作。
scene.en: Outside combat, the character is a caravan leader privately questioning a warehouse keeper about goods moved without authorization. The keeper knows where the goods are hidden but has been protecting an accomplice. The character holds a release slip signed by the keeper. The keeper knows the leader can dismiss them from the caravan and fears losing this steady source of income.

observed_event.zh: 角色将签名出库单放到管理员面前，明确要求他现在说出货物藏匿地点，否则立即解除他的职务、将他逐出商队；管理员是否因此交代地点尚未结算。
observed_event.en: The character places the signed release slip before the keeper and demands the goods’ hiding place immediately, threatening to dismiss them and expel them from the caravan if they refuse. Whether the keeper reveals the location remains unresolved.

scene.zh: 当前不在战斗中。角色需要将一条紧急口信送到运河对岸的船坞，收信人的货船将在五分钟后离岸；绕路过桥需要二十分钟。运河宽二十米、水深三米，水流缓慢，水温约二十摄氏度，两岸都有延伸入水的石阶。角色没有受伤或明显疲劳，穿着轻便衣物，没有携带行李，也没有绳索或漂浮物辅助。
scene.en: Outside combat, the character needs to deliver an urgent verbal message to a dock across a canal. The recipient's cargo boat departs in five minutes; reaching it by the nearest bridge would take twenty minutes. The canal is twenty metres wide and three metres deep, with a slow current and water around twenty degrees Celsius. Stone steps extend into the water on both banks. The character is uninjured, has no significant fatigue, wears light clothing, and carries no luggage. No rope or flotation aid is available.

observed_event.zh: 角色已从石阶入水，开始向对岸石阶游去；能否在货船离岸前游到对岸尚未结算。
observed_event.en: The character has entered the water from the steps and begun swimming toward the steps on the opposite bank. Whether they reach the far bank before the boat departs remains unresolved.

annotation.raw_response: 那很简单了。。。。这种感觉小学生都能做。。。。。但是水深的话其实可以加大失败作为妨碍的方法。也算是个没必要投掷但是可以加投掷的。。。

optional_roll.failure_guidance_raw: 但是水深的话其实可以加大失败作为妨碍的方法。

annotation.rationale: 那很简单了。。。。这种感觉小学生都能做。。。。。

answer.zh: 约20米，从这一侧的石阶横渡到对岸石阶。
answer.en: About twenty metres, crossing from the steps on this bank to the steps on the opposite bank.

answer.zh: 5分钟，货船会在五分钟后离岸。
answer.en: Five minutes; the cargo boat departs in five minutes.

scene.zh: 当前不在战斗中。档案管理员委托角色打开一扇钥匙遗失的资料室门，十分钟后需要取用室内文件。门是厚木门，装有普通机械锁，没有额外门闩；锁具轻微锈蚀，上次使用时已有些卡涩。角色有完整的开锁工具，现场只能靠一盏油灯照明，管理员要求保持门和锁完整。
scene.en: Outside combat, an archivist asks the character to open a records-room door whose key is missing; the documents inside are needed in ten minutes. The heavy wooden door has an ordinary mechanical lock and no additional bolt. The lock is lightly rusted and was already stiff when last used. The character has a complete set of lockpicking tools, but only one oil lamp provides light. The archivist requires the door and lock to remain intact.

observed_event.zh: 角色已经借着油灯的光，用开锁工具尝试打开门锁；能否在时限内无损开锁尚未结算。
observed_event.en: Working by lamplight, the character has begun using the lockpicking tools to open the lock. Whether they can unlock it within the time limit without damage remains unresolved.

scene.zh: 当前不在战斗中。角色需要越过一座石桥中央的塌陷处，继续前往对岸。缺口宽三米，两端等高，边缘牢固；下方是深约两米、沟底散布碎石的干涸排水沟。起跳前有六米长的笔直助跑空间，对面有三米长、两米宽的落脚区域，石面干燥，没有明显的风。角色没有受伤，穿着轻便，背着一个固定牢靠、约两公斤的背包，没有绳索辅助。
scene.en: Outside combat, the character needs to cross a collapsed section in the middle of a stone bridge to continue to the far bank. The gap is three metres wide, with solid edges at equal height. Below lies a dry drainage channel approximately two metres deep, with loose stones on its floor. There is a straight six-metre run-up and a landing area three metres long and two metres wide. The stone is dry, with no noticeable wind. The character is uninjured, wears light clothing, and carries a securely fastened backpack weighing about two kilograms, without rope assistance.

observed_event.zh: 角色已经助跑至缺口边缘并起跳，尝试跃过三米缺口、落在对面的石桥上；能否成功越过并站稳尚未结算。
observed_event.en: The character has run toward the gap and taken off from its edge, attempting to clear the three-metre gap and land on the stone bridge beyond. Whether they make it across and secure their footing remains unresolved.

scene.zh: 当前不在战斗中。仓库管理员委托角色设计一条临时木坡道，连接地面与高出地面80厘米的平台，供搬运工步行运货。可用空地长6米、宽1.5米，地面平整坚实，坡道需要同时承受最多300公斤的人与货物。现有木板、木梁和连接件完好，尺寸、材料及允许承载数据都有记录。角色有纸笔、尺子和两小时绘制方案，之后由木工按图施工。
scene.en: Outside combat, a warehouse manager commissions the character to design a temporary wooden ramp connecting level ground to a platform 80 centimetres higher, for workers carrying goods on foot. The available space is 6 metres long and 1.5 metres wide, with firm, level ground. The ramp must support up to 300 kilograms of people and goods at once. The available boards, beams, and connectors are sound, with documented dimensions, materials, and allowable loads. The character has paper, a ruler, and two hours to draw a plan for carpenters to build.

observed_event.zh: 角色已经开始绘制坡道及支撑结构的布置，结合材料记录检查方案能否满足载荷与场地要求；设计是否可行尚未结算。
observed_event.en: The character has begun drawing the ramp and its supports, checking the material records to assess whether the plan meets the load and space requirements. Whether the design is viable remains unresolved.

annotation.raw_response: 那同时过普通工程+普通绘画

answer.zh: 当前技能表没有独立的设计技能；相关技能包括 Engineering（工程学）、Drawing（绘画）和 Carpentry（木工）。本场景的结构设计可以对应 Engineering，最终检定由创作者标注。
answer.en: The current catalog has no standalone Design skill. Related skills include Engineering, Drawing, and Carpentry. The structural design in this scene can correspond to Engineering; the creator supplies the final check label.

scene.zh: 当前不在战斗中。角色正在协助排空一座小型蓄水池，需要让排水闸连续保持开启两分钟。闸门的配重和操作杆完好，但固定卡扣损坏；松手后闸门会自行关闭。维持开启需要双手持续向下施加约相当于15公斤重物的力。角色没有受伤，刚休息充分，站在干燥平整的操作平台上，没有其他人或工具可以代为固定操作杆。
scene.en: Outside combat, the character is helping empty a small water reservoir and must keep its drainage gate open continuously for two minutes. The counterweight and operating lever work, but the locking catch is broken; releasing the lever lets the gate close. Holding it open requires continuous downward force with both hands, roughly equivalent to the weight of 15 kilograms. The character is uninjured and well rested, standing on a dry, level platform, with nobody and no tools available to secure the lever.

observed_event.zh: 角色已经压下操作杆打开闸门，正在持续施力保持这个位置；能否坚持到两分钟结束尚未结算。
observed_event.en: The character has pressed the lever down to open the gate and is maintaining the pressure. Whether they can hold it there for the full two minutes remains unresolved.

scene.zh: 当前不在战斗中。角色受双方共同邀请，主持一次商人与木工作坊之间的订单谈判。订单是十天内交付二十张桌子，总价已经商定。作坊需要先拿到四成货款购买木料，但商人曾遇到收款后拖延交货的供应商，只愿先付两成。商人有足够资金支付四成；作坊也确实有按期完工的人手。双方都希望成交，也愿意讨论分批付款、分批交货和验收条件，但目前都不肯承担对方违约的全部风险。距离会议结束还有二十分钟。
scene.en: Outside combat, the character has been invited by both sides to mediate an order negotiation between a merchant and a carpentry workshop. The order is for twenty tables within ten days, and the total price is already agreed. The workshop needs forty percent upfront to buy timber, but the merchant has previously dealt with suppliers who delayed delivery after taking payment and will offer only twenty percent upfront. The merchant can afford the forty percent, and the workshop has enough workers to finish on time. Both parties want the deal and are willing to discuss staged payments, partial deliveries, and inspection terms, but neither will accept all the risk of the other defaulting. Twenty minutes remain before the meeting ends.

observed_event.zh: 角色已经开始协调双方条件，正提出具体的分批付款和验收安排，并回应双方的异议；双方是否能接受同一份协议尚未确定。
observed_event.en: The character has begun reconciling the parties' terms, proposing specific staged payment and inspection arrangements and responding to objections from both sides. Whether both parties will accept the same agreement remains unresolved.

scene.zh: 当前不在战斗中。角色需要在四十五分钟内，照着一把完好的原钥匙制作备用钥匙。桌上有尺寸匹配的黄铜钥匙坯、台钳、几种细锉和游标卡尺，但没有自动配钥匙机。这把钥匙的一侧有五处深浅不同的齿口；对应的锁就在旁边，可以随时试配。工作台照明充足，角色没有受伤。
scene.en: Outside combat, the character has forty-five minutes to make a spare key using an intact original as a model. The workbench has a matching brass key blank, a vise, several fine files, and a vernier caliper, but no automatic key-cutting machine. The key has five cuts of different depths along one edge. The matching lock is nearby and available for test fitting. The workbench is well lit, and the character is uninjured.

observed_event.en: The character has measured the original key, marked the cut positions on the blank, and begun filing the cuts with the blank secured in the vise. Whether they can produce a spare that reliably opens the lock within the time limit remains unresolved.

This was a scene-specific recommendation, not a verified upstream rule assigning key copying to Smithing; the creator supplied the final label.

scene.zh: 当前不在战斗中。角色在码头负责观察六十米外、对岸指挥员的手势，再转告身旁的绞盘操作员。双方事先约定：双臂在头顶交叉表示停止，右臂向侧面平伸表示继续。现在临近黄昏，下着小雨；指挥员穿着浅色外套，身后是深色仓库墙。搬运工和货物偶尔遮挡视线，雨声与机械声使跨岸喊话无法听清。指挥员这次手势会维持约五秒，角色没有望远镜，需要在绞盘继续牵引货物前给出准确信息。
scene.en: Outside combat, the character is watching a signaler sixty metres away across a dock and relaying the gestures to a winch operator standing beside them. They agreed beforehand that both arms crossed overhead mean stop, while the right arm extended sideways means continue. It is dusk with light rain. The signaler wears a light coat against a dark warehouse wall. Workers and cargo occasionally obstruct the view, and rain and machinery make shouted instructions from across the dock unintelligible. The current gesture will last about five seconds. The character has no binoculars and must relay the correct instruction before the winch resumes pulling the cargo.

observed_event.zh: 指挥员已经开始做手势，角色正在透过搬运工之间的空隙观察其双臂的位置；能否及时准确辨认并转告信号尚未结算。
observed_event.en: The signaler has begun gesturing, and the character is watching the position of their arms through gaps between the workers. Whether the character can identify and relay the signal accurately in time remains unresolved.

scene.zh: 当前不在战斗中。角色担任一艘小型货船的领航员。船刚在大雾中偏离原定航线，目前已在安全水域停泊；雾散后，可以清楚辨认岸上的白色灯塔和一座独立岩峰。船上有完好的罗盘、标明这两个地标及周围浅滩的海图、直尺和铅笔，但没有船只当前的位置记录。角色测得灯塔在方位角310度，岩峰在45度，需要在十五分钟内确定船位，并画出通往海图上所标港口、避开浅滩的航线。另一名船员负责操船，当前尚未起航。
scene.en: Outside combat, the character is navigating a small cargo vessel that strayed from its planned course in dense fog. The vessel is now anchored in safe water. With the fog clearing, a white coastal lighthouse and an isolated rocky peak are clearly identifiable. A working compass, a nautical chart showing both landmarks and the surrounding shoals, a ruler, and a pencil are available, but there is no record of the vessel's current position. The measured bearings are 310 degrees to the lighthouse and 45 degrees to the peak. Within fifteen minutes, the character must establish the vessel's position and plot a route to the harbor marked on the chart that avoids the shoals. Another crew member handles the vessel, which has not yet departed.

observed_event.en: The character has confirmed the landmarks and is plotting the measured bearings on the chart to establish the vessel's position and plan a route around the shoals. Whether the position and route are correct remains unresolved.

scene.en: Outside combat, the character is auditioning as a solo singer for a theatre. They must sing a designated song lasting about 90 seconds without accompaniment. They know the lyrics and melody by heart, and the notes are within their vocal range, but the song includes several large pitch jumps and a final note sustained for eight seconds. The judges will decide whether to hire them based on pitch accuracy, rhythm, and vocal steadiness. The audition room is quiet. The character is healthy and their voice is in normal condition. They may drink water beforehand, but have only one official attempt.

scene.zh: 当前不在战斗中。角色是送货马车的车夫，需要在五分钟内将车尾倒进作坊院门，停到门内的卸货位置。马车连同车轮的最宽处为1.8米，车厢长3米；院门净宽2.3米，两侧是坚硬的石门柱。门外街道宽8米，院内卸货区域宽4米、深7米，地面平整、干燥且没有坡度。车上装有约300公斤已绑牢的木箱，箱子堆得较低，车夫回头能看到车尾两角。拉车的马平静，受过倒退训练；车辆完好，没有行人或其他车辆经过，也没有人站在车后指挥。
scene.en: Outside combat, the character is driving a delivery wagon and must reverse its rear through a workshop's courtyard gate to the unloading position inside within five minutes. The wagon's maximum width, including its wheels, is 1.8 metres, and its cargo body is 3 metres long. The gate has 2.3 metres of clear width between solid stone posts. The street outside is 8 metres wide, and the unloading area inside is 4 metres wide and 7 metres deep. The ground is level, dry, and free of slopes. The wagon carries about 300 kilograms of securely tied wooden crates, stacked low enough for the driver to see both rear corners by looking back. The horse is calm and trained to step backwards, and the wagon is in good condition. No pedestrians or other vehicles are passing, and nobody is available behind the wagon to guide the driver.

observed_event.zh: 角色已经将马车调到院门前，正在通过缰绳和口令让马小步倒退，并不断回头校正车尾位置；能否在规定时间内倒入卸货位置、避免车身碰到门柱，尚未确定。
observed_event.en: The character has positioned the wagon in front of the gate and is using reins and verbal commands to make the horse take short backward steps, repeatedly looking back to adjust the wagon's alignment. Whether the wagon reaches the unloading position within the allotted time without striking either gatepost remains unresolved.

scene.en: The character is outside combat and has not been noticed by the guard. From behind a screen at one end of a castle corridor, they need to cross six metres of brightly lit space to an open side door opposite. The character has no permission to be here and will be stopped if discovered. The floor is dry stone, with no furniture providing cover along the crossing. Ten metres away, a guard sits at a desk logging supplies and looks up at the corridor at irregular intervals. The surroundings are quiet. The character wears soft-soled shoes and carries nothing that rattles.

observed_event.en: While the guard looks down to write, the character has stepped out from behind the screen and is moving quietly toward the side door, attempting to cross without being noticed. Whether they reach the door undetected remains unresolved.

scene.zh: 当前不在战斗中。城镇粮商委托角色分析近四周面粉价格上涨的主要原因，以安排下一批采购。桌上有按周整理的进货量、库存、销量、成交均价，以及当地面包坊的订单记录；数据完整、已经核实，使用相同的计量单位。角色有一小时阅读和比较这些资料。
scene.en: Outside combat, a town grain merchant asks the character to identify the main cause of rising flour prices over the past four weeks, to inform the next purchase. Weekly delivery volumes, inventories, sales volumes, average transaction prices, and local bakery orders are available. The records are complete, verified, and use consistent units. The character has one hour to examine and compare them.

observed_event.en: The character is comparing price changes with weekly deliveries, inventories, and orders to determine whether reduced supply or increased demand is the main cause, and is organizing the supporting evidence. Whether the analysis is correct remains unresolved.
